jobs.title: Senior Manager, CRM Engineering, Administration & Development - Field Enablement
jobs.description:
Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Position Responsibilities

Define and lead the AI-powered Engineering & Development across the CRM capabilities — identifying and delivering AI-enabled solutions that create measurable business value, reduce manual effort, and elevate the intelligence of commercial field tools - embedded within Veeva CRM UIX layers.
Champion an AI-first engineering mindset — embedding AI coding assistants, LLM-augmented development workflows, and automated testing into day-to-day engineering practice to accelerate delivery and raise code quality.
Drive platform simplification and intelligent automation programs — rationalizing legacy configurations, eliminating high-effort manual workflows through AI-driven orchestration, and replacing complexity with elegant, automated, and scalable solutions.
Lead agentic AI experiments and enterprise pilots — designing AI agents that autonomously manage CRM workflows, enrich data, route actions, and surface intelligent field recommendations via CRM APIs and third-party data sources.
Establish AI governance and responsible AI frameworks within CRM engineering — ensuring all AI solutions comply with BMS AI policies, data privacy regulations, explainability standards, and validated systems requirements.
Lead the end-to-end UIX strategy for Veeva CRM field-facing interfaces — including rep/manager screens, MyInsights/X-Pages, and embedded dashboards — and lead their architecture and development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Veeva JavaScript SDK, and Java SDK.
Define and enforce UIX design standards, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns across the global CRM engineering team to ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability.
Lead all aspects of Veeva CRM platform administration — user/territory management, security models, profiles, permission sets, role hierarchies, object configurations, workflow rules, approval processes, automation triggers, SSO, reporting/dashboard infrastructure, and data loading operations.
Govern CRM environment strategy — sandbox, UAT, staging, and production — with disciplined promotion workflows, configuration trackers, and change management controls aligned to validated systems standards.
Lead custom development initiatives using Java SDK, scripting languages (Groovy, JavaScript, Shell), and Veeva-native frameworks — delivering controllers, SDK-based logic layers, event handlers, background services, integration connectors, and a governed reusable code library.
Design and implement CRM integration solutions — RESTful/SOAP APIs, middleware connectors, event-driven pipelines, and batch data exchange workflows — connecting Veeva CRM with MDM, ERP, AI/ML services, Veeva Vault, and Salesforce.
Drive CI/CD adoption and DevOps best practices — automated deployment pipelines, environment promotion workflows, code reviews, Git-based version control, coding standards enforcement, and GxP/GCP-compliant release automation.
Lead innovation forums, hackathons, and technology showcases — fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and breakthrough thinking across onshore, nearshore, and offshore engineering communities.
Set the technical vision and engineering roadmap for the CRM Administration & Development stream — aligning platform capabilities, custom development priorities, and AI/automation investments with BMS's commercial IT strategy.
Prototype and demonstrate new CRM and AI capabilities — building proof-of-concept solutions to validate feasibility, de-risk delivery, and support executive roadmap planning and investment decisions.
Drive portfolio-level technical risk management — identifying systemic risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and compliance gaps, and driving structured remediation programs across the CRM platform estate.
Lead, develop, and inspire a globally distributed team of CRM developers, administrators, UIX engineers, and AI specialists — setting technical direction, building AI and CRM competency, and fostering a high-performance, innovation-led culture across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations.
Manage vendor & partner relationships — influencing product roadmaps, driving SLA accountability, resolving escalations, and identifying strategic partnership opportunities.
Partner with Product Owners, Commercial Business Teams, and cross-matrix IT teams (Data, AI/ML, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture) to translate strategic business needs into scalable, AI-enabled CRM solutions with clear value outcomes.
Drive global delivery governance — facilitating agile ceremonies, maintaining program-level transparency, and ensuring cross-geo delivery cadence, milestone predictability, and audit-ready delivery artifacts at all times.
Communicate risks, issues, and delivery impacts to senior management with actionable strategies, contingency plans, and executive-ready status narratives.

Requirements

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
9+ years of overall IT experience in CRM software development, platform administration, and enterprise solution delivery — with demonstrated experience in senior technical leadership roles.
5+ years of hands-on Veeva CRM experience — with deep expertise across platform administration, UIX/MyInsights/X-Pages development, custom development (Java SDK, scripting), security models, profiles, objects, controllers, workflows, SSO, permission sets, reports, dashboards, data loading, and integrations.
3+ years of hands-on custom development experience using Java, Java SDK (Veeva), JavaScript, or equivalent scripting languages within CRM or enterprise application environments.
1+ years of applied AI/ML, intelligent automation, or Generative AI experience — including designing, building, or operationalizing AI-enabled solutions within enterprise CRM or field technology environments.
4+ years of experience with SDLC methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), validated and regulated system delivery in the life sciences domain, and cloud-native application development.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing CRM integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or event-driven architectures.
Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed engineering teams — including onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models.
At least 2 active relevant technical certifications.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills — with a proven ability of presenting to leadership and cross-functional technical audiences.

Additionally Preferred

Deep expertise in Life Science CRM capabilities - Account management, affiliations, MyInsights/X-Pages, product metrics, MCCP, sampling, Approved Email, Engage, territory management, media content, Call/eMIRF, suggestions, surveys, iRep configurations, Event Managements and integrations.
Experience integrating CRM with AI/ML platforms and services — surfacing predictive model outputs, next-best-action, or intelligent insights within CRM UIX layers.
Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for automated CRM configuration deployment and SDK build pipelines.
Familiarity with master data management (MDM) processes relevant to CRM data governance — HCP/HCO data, territory hierarchies, and product catalog management.
Prior experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, or healthcare — with knowledge of commercial field operations, medical affairs, market access, or sales force effectiveness (SFE) workflows.
Additional Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault, Salesforce, or cloud platform certifications.
Experience with agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure Boards — backlog management, sprint execution, and stakeholder reporting.
Demonstrated ability to manage global teams and vendor relationships across a matrixed organization — influencing without authority and driving outcomes across broad stakeholder groups.

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

jobs.description:

Key Responsibilities

Architect, build, and deliver solution architectures for content & digital platforms and the Marketing AI platform — hands-on writing production-grade backend code (Python, Node.js), APIs (REST/GraphQL), data pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.
Serve as Technical Lead for the end-to-end Azure-to-AWS migration of the Marketing AI platform — including service mapping, data migration, workload re-platforming, and cutover — and design the target-state AWS architecture using Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
Build and deploy agentic AI applications — autonomous marketing agents for content generation, audience segmentation, campaign orchestration, and real-time personalization — using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom orchestration, with proper governance including human-in-the-loop checkpoints and responsible AI practices.
Support the north-star vision of automating end-to-end marketing workflows working with the Marketing AI & Innovation Engineering Lead — from insight generation and content creation through approval, distribution, channel activation, and performance measurement — to increase speed-to-market and enable personalized marketing at scale.
Drive DevOps and cloud infrastructure — design and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins), manage Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CDK/CloudFormation), container orchestration (ECS/EKS/Kubernetes), serverless deployments, environment strategy (dev/staging/prod), and enforce best practices for automated testing, blue/green deployments, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
Ensure platform security, compliance, and cost optimization — hands-on with IAM, secrets management, VPC/network security, encryption, and data privacy controls; monitor resource utilization, implement auto-scaling, right-size compute, and establish cost governance.
Lead full-stack and backend engineering — design and build microservices, event-driven architectures, database solutions (PostgreSQL/RDS, DynamoDB/DocumentDB), data pipelines (AWS Glue, PySpark, Airflow), and AI/ML pipelines (SageMaker, Bedrock); build frontend components (React.js, TypeScript) as needed.
Implement robust integration patterns connecting the Marketing AI platform and content/digital platforms with the broader ecosystem (Veeva, AEM, DAM, CRM, CDP, analytics tools) via APIs, event streams, and middleware such as MuleSoft or webMethods.
Lead PoCs and pilots—from ideation to working prototype—for agentic marketing use cases (e.g., AI-driven personalization, automated MLR pre-checks, intelligent content repurposing), and scale successful pilots to production.
Lead by example — actively contributing code, conducting architecture reviews, pair-programming, and providing hands-on technical mentorship to elevate team engineering quality and maintain alignment with architectural standards and best practices.
Manage technical roadmaps, architecture documentation, and CLAD processes — ensure phased delivery with minimal business disruption, clear rollback strategies, and measurable success criteria; drive continuous improvement for productivity, cost savings, and engineering velocity.
Partner cross-functionally with CASA Leads, C-BI&T, Cloud Engineering, Cyber Security, Data & Enterprise Architecture, vendor partners, and agency teams to ensure successful delivery across all content, digital, and AI capabilities.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field with 8+ years of hands-on IT engineering and architecture experience, including 6+ years in a hands-on technical architect / lead engineer role for content, digital, and/or AI platforms.
4-5 years of heavy backend engineering—building production-grade APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, and data pipelines using Python, Node.js, or Java.
4-5 years of hands-on DevOps and AWS cloud infrastructure—CI/CD pipeline design, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK/CloudFormation), container orchestration (ECS/EKS/Kubernetes), serverless architectures, and environment management—with demonstrated experience in cloud migration (Azure-to-AWS preferred) and/or AI/ML platform development.
Strong full-stack capabilities—backend and DevOps as core strengths—with working proficiency in frontend (React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript) and hands-on experience with both relational (PostgreSQL, RDS) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, DocumentDB).
Experience with AI/ML and GenAI - Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, LLM-based application development, prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar).
Strong understanding of IT governance processes including data architecture, data privacy, cyber security reviews, risk assessments, Git-based workflows, and modern software engineering standards.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—ability to distill complex technical concepts into simple business language, present confidently to senior leaders, and work cooperatively across boundaries within a matrix organization.
Familiarity with the Pharmaceutical Industry.

Desired Experience

Digital marketing and commercialization domain experience—including MarTech ecosystems.
AI/ML for marketing use cases—content personalization, audience segmentation, campaign optimization, and understanding of agentic AI architectures including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, and human-in-the-loop design.
Experience with ETL tools (AWS Glue, Informatica) and integration platforms (MuleSoft, webMethods).
Enterprise application integration experience - designing large-scale system-to-system integrations across CRM, ERP, CDP, CMS, MLR & DAM, using middleware, API gateways, event-driven architectures, and message brokers (Kafka, SQS/SNS), including enterprise integration patterns (EIP), iPaaS solutions, and integration architecture governance (API standards, versioning, SLA management, observability).
Expertise in SDLC methodologies (Agile, Lean, Waterfall) and ability to manage business process analysis, cost-benefit estimation, and post-implementation KPI delivery.
Ability to scan the technical landscape for leading-edge solutions, create business cases for new investments, and potential to develop into a recognized thought-leader for content, digital, and AI capabilities.

Other Experience

Working knowledge of agile software development lifecycle methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to support a dynamic culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
Potential to develop into an internally/externally recognized thought-leader for content & digital capabilities.

jobs.title: Director, Global Security Technology (Remote)
jobs.description:
The Director, Global Security Technology leads the strategy, architecture, and operating model for a global portfolio of enterprise physical security technology platforms, ensuring scalable, resilient, and integrated capabilities that support business operations, risk management, and digital transformation. This role provides strategic leadership for the Technology Security Center of Excellence (TSCoE) and is accountable for the architecture, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of enterprise security technology solutions, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, alarm systems and related data and analytics capabilities.

This role operates at the intersection of physical security and enterprise information technology, applying modern technology practices – including platform strategy, systems integration, data architecture, and automation – to deliver business-aligned security capabilities.

This leader will partner closely with Enterprise Digital & Technology (EDT), Global Real Estate & Facilities, Procurement, HR, Legal, Privacy, and Regional Security leaders to ensure physical security technologies are aligned to enterprise architecture, embedded in site design and business processes, and positioned to support future growth. The role will leverage emerging technologies, automation, and analytics to strengthen decision-making, operational consistency, and business resilience globally.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics, Research Business Insights & Technology
jobs.description:
Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Role Overview

Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking a strategic, scientifically grounded leader to serve as the Senior Director for Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics. This leader will partner deeply with Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacometrics, Quantitative Pharmacology, and Translational Medicine stakeholders to deliver the applications, modeling environments, workflow automation, and governed operational capabilities that support CPP work end to end—from quantitative preclinical-to-clinical bridging through clinical PK/PD, dose and regimen decisions, and submission-support outputs.

This role supports the quantitative CPP layer across Research and Development, including pharmacometric workflows, clinical PK/PD systems, modeling platforms, reporting automation, regulatory evidence generation, and the governed operational capabilities required to run these workflows at scale.

Reporting to the Vice President, Research Business Insights & Technology, this leader will operate as part of a unified BI&T leadership team and act as a trusted partner to Research and Development leadership. The role carries accountability for the reliability, fit-for-purpose evolution, and long-term scaling of the CPP technology stack and workflow ecosystem, while working in a highly matrixed model with scientific leaders, data teams, lab-platform teams, and regulatory-facing partners.

Mission & Impact

Provide a scalable application and workflow backbone for CPP across preclinical-to-clinical translation, clinical PK/PD, dose selection, exposure-response, and model-informed development decisions
Improve the speed, quality, reproducibility, traceability, and inspection-readiness of pharmacometrics and clinical pharmacology workflows
Strengthen regulatory submissions through robust reporting, reusable quantitative evidence generation, and auditable outputs that support documents such as clinical pharmacology summaries and model-based appendices
Enable governed automation of priority CPP workflows, including reporting, simulation, execution, review, and knowledge reuse
Create a durable technology foundation for end-to-end CPP that can scale with pipeline demand and integrate cleanly across the broader Research and Development ecosystem

Sub-Areas in Scope

Clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics applications, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose optimization, and model-informed decision support
PBPK, QSP, drug-drug interaction, and other quantitative modeling environments used in CPP workflows
Clinical PK/PD systems and operational tooling that support end-to-end CPP execution
CPAR, Quarto-based or similar reporting automation, and submission-support workflows for quantitative regulatory deliverables
Quantitative translational workflows that bridge preclinical and clinical evidence in support of CPP decision-making
Workflow governance, audit trails, validation support, access controls, and inspection-ready operational practices for regulated quantitative environments
AI-enabled and advanced analytics capabilities that improve CPP workflow efficiency, simulation, review, reporting, and knowledge reuse
In partnership, but not sole ownership: translational labs, pathology, molecular and imaging lab workflows, CLIA-oriented lab operations, precision medicine diagnostics, and broad bioanalytical capabilities

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the single BI&T point of accountability for CPP technology, applications, workflows, and support services end to end
Partner across Research and Development to integrate CPP workflows with the scientific, data, and operational capabilities required for model-informed drug development
Own clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics applications, modeling environments, reporting workflows, and operational support for core CPP use cases
Ensure operational excellence, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement across modeling environments, clinical PK/PD systems, reporting workflows, and submission-support applications
Lead automation of priority CPP workflows, including model execution, reporting, simulation, traceability, review, and evidence reuse
Support quantitative regulatory deliverables through fit-for-purpose tooling, reproducible workflows, and inspection-ready practices
Partner with Unified Lab & Experimental Platforms, Target & Disease Biology, and In-Vivo & Non-Clinical Pharmacology where translational science, lab systems, diagnostics, biomarker workflows, or bioanalytical capabilities intersect with CPP needs
Partner with the R&D Data organization on underlying data-product strategy, integration, and fit-for-purpose data access
Lead and grow a team of scientific technologists, product leaders, and specialized engineers aligned to this domain

Required Experience & Qualifications

Ph.D. in Pharmacometrics, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biostatistics, or related quantitative field
12+ years in pharmaceutical R&D with deep clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and model-informed drug development experience
Proven experience implementing or leading CPP applications, PBPK and QSP environments, clinical PK/PD systems, or quantitative workflow automation
Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory submissions, quantitative reporting, and governed workflows in Development-facing settings
Experience applying AI/ML or advanced automation to quantitative modeling, reporting, or regulated scientific workflows is preferred
Director or Senior Director-level leadership experience; experience building and scaling a specialized scientific technology team is a strong differentiator

Critical Capabilities

Scientific Depth in Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics — Deep credibility with quantitative scientists and domain leaders across CPP
Strategic Partnership — Translates scientific and Development needs into practical, integrated technology and workflow solutions
Operational Leadership — Builds reliable, scalable, inspection-ready environments and support models for critical quantitative workflows
Regulatory Translation Capability — Understands how quantitative evidence is prepared, reported, reviewed, and used in regulatory settings

Leadership & Change Attributes

Strong partnership with senior scientific, clinical, and regulatory leaders
Comfort operating with regulatory and global Development stakeholders
Ability to recruit, develop, and retain highly specialized quantitative talent in a competitive market
Experience navigating matrixed organizations and building credibility quickly
Commitment to building a collaborative, high-performing culture in a growing team

What Differentiates Top Candidates

Experience as a clinical pharmacology or pharmacometrics technology leader inside a top-tier pharmaceutical R&D organization
Track record of applications, workflows, or platforms that improved dose selection, quantitative decision-making, or regulatory execution in Development-facing settings
Experience deploying workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, or advanced analytics in support of end-to-end CPP modeling, reporting, and decision-support operations
Demonstrated success building a specialized function from foundational capability to scaled organizational value while operating through strong matrix partnerships

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Compensation Overview

Define and lead the AI-powered Engineering & Development across the CRM capabilities — identifying and delivering AI-enabled solutions that create measurable business value, reduce manual effort, and elevate the intelligence of commercial field tools - embedded within Veeva CRM UIX layers.
Champion an AI-first engineering mindset — embedding AI coding assistants, LLM-augmented development workflows, and automated testing into day-to-day engineering practice to accelerate delivery and raise code quality.
Drive platform simplification and intelligent automation programs — rationalizing legacy configurations, eliminating high-effort manual workflows through AI-driven orchestration, and replacing complexity with elegant, automated, and scalable solutions.
Lead agentic AI experiments and enterprise pilots — designing AI agents that autonomously manage CRM workflows, enrich data, route actions, and surface intelligent field recommendations via CRM APIs and third-party data sources.
Establish AI governance and responsible AI frameworks within CRM engineering — ensuring all AI solutions comply with BMS AI policies, data privacy regulations, explainability standards, and validated systems requirements.
Lead the end-to-end UIX strategy for Veeva CRM field-facing interfaces — including rep/manager screens, MyInsights/X-Pages, and embedded dashboards — and lead their architecture and development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Veeva JavaScript SDK, and Java SDK.
Define and enforce UIX design standards, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns across the global CRM engineering team to ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability.
Lead all aspects of Veeva CRM platform administration — user/territory management, security models, profiles, permission sets, role hierarchies, object configurations, workflow rules, approval processes, automation triggers, SSO, reporting/dashboard infrastructure, and data loading operations.
Govern CRM environment strategy — sandbox, UAT, staging, and production — with disciplined promotion workflows, configuration trackers, and change management controls aligned to validated systems standards.
Lead custom development initiatives using Java SDK, scripting languages (Groovy, JavaScript, Shell), and Veeva-native frameworks — delivering controllers, SDK-based logic layers, event handlers, background services, integration connectors, and a governed reusable code library.
Design and implement CRM integration solutions — RESTful/SOAP APIs, middleware connectors, event-driven pipelines, and batch data exchange workflows — connecting Veeva CRM with MDM, ERP, AI/ML services, Veeva Vault, and Salesforce.
Drive CI/CD adoption and DevOps best practices — automated deployment pipelines, environment promotion workflows, code reviews, Git-based version control, coding standards enforcement, and GxP/GCP-compliant release automation.
Lead innovation forums, hackathons, and technology showcases — fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and breakthrough thinking across onshore, nearshore, and offshore engineering communities.
Set the technical vision and engineering roadmap for the CRM Administration & Development stream — aligning platform capabilities, custom development priorities, and AI/automation investments with BMS's commercial IT strategy.
Prototype and demonstrate new CRM and AI capabilities — building proof-of-concept solutions to validate feasibility, de-risk delivery, and support executive roadmap planning and investment decisions.
Drive portfolio-level technical risk management — identifying systemic risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and compliance gaps, and driving structured remediation programs across the CRM platform estate.
Lead, develop, and inspire a globally distributed team of CRM developers, administrators, UIX engineers, and AI specialists — setting technical direction, building AI and CRM competency, and fostering a high-performance, innovation-led culture across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations.
Manage vendor & partner relationships — influencing product roadmaps, driving SLA accountability, resolving escalations, and identifying strategic partnership opportunities.
Partner with Product Owners, Commercial Business Teams, and cross-matrix IT teams (Data, AI/ML, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture) to translate strategic business needs into scalable, AI-enabled CRM solutions with clear value outcomes.
Drive global delivery governance — facilitating agile ceremonies, maintaining program-level transparency, and ensuring cross-geo delivery cadence, milestone predictability, and audit-ready delivery artifacts at all times.
Communicate risks, issues, and delivery impacts to senior management with actionable strategies, contingency plans, and executive-ready status narratives.

Requirements

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
9+ years of overall IT experience in CRM software development, platform administration, and enterprise solution delivery — with demonstrated experience in senior technical leadership roles.
5+ years of hands-on Veeva CRM experience — with deep expertise across platform administration, UIX/MyInsights/X-Pages development, custom development (Java SDK, scripting), security models, profiles, objects, controllers, workflows, SSO, permission sets, reports, dashboards, data loading, and integrations.
3+ years of hands-on custom development experience using Java, Java SDK (Veeva), JavaScript, or equivalent scripting languages within CRM or enterprise application environments.
1+ years of applied AI/ML, intelligent automation, or Generative AI experience — including designing, building, or operationalizing AI-enabled solutions within enterprise CRM or field technology environments.
4+ years of experience with SDLC methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), validated and regulated system delivery in the life sciences domain, and cloud-native application development.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing CRM integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or event-driven architectures.
Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed engineering teams — including onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models.
At least 2 active relevant technical certifications.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills — with a proven ability of presenting to leadership and cross-functional technical audiences.

Additionally Preferred

Deep expertise in Life Science CRM capabilities - Account management, affiliations, MyInsights/X-Pages, product metrics, MCCP, sampling, Approved Email, Engage, territory management, media content, Call/eMIRF, suggestions, surveys, iRep configurations, Event Managements and integrations.
Experience integrating CRM with AI/ML platforms and services — surfacing predictive model outputs, next-best-action, or intelligent insights within CRM UIX layers.
Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for automated CRM configuration deployment and SDK build pipelines.
Familiarity with master data management (MDM) processes relevant to CRM data governance — HCP/HCO data, territory hierarchies, and product catalog management.
Prior experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, or healthcare — with knowledge of commercial field operations, medical affairs, market access, or sales force effectiveness (SFE) workflows.
Additional Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault, Salesforce, or cloud platform certifications.
Experience with agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure Boards — backlog management, sprint execution, and stakeholder reporting.
Demonstrated ability to manage global teams and vendor relationships across a matrixed organization — influencing without authority and driving outcomes across broad stakeholder groups.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field with 8+ years of hands-on IT engineering and architecture experience, including 6+ years in a hands-on technical architect / lead engineer role for content, digital, and/or AI platforms.
4-5 years of heavy backend engineering—building production-grade APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, and data pipelines using Python, Node.js, or Java.
4-5 years of hands-on DevOps and AWS cloud infrastructure—CI/CD pipeline design, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK/CloudFormation), container orchestration (ECS/EKS/Kubernetes), serverless architectures, and environment management—with demonstrated experience in cloud migration (Azure-to-AWS preferred) and/or AI/ML platform development.
Strong full-stack capabilities—backend and DevOps as core strengths—with working proficiency in frontend (React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript) and hands-on experience with both relational (PostgreSQL, RDS) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, DocumentDB).
Experience with AI/ML and GenAI - Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, LLM-based application development, prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar).
Strong understanding of IT governance processes including data architecture, data privacy, cyber security reviews, risk assessments, Git-based workflows, and modern software engineering standards.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—ability to distill complex technical concepts into simple business language, present confidently to senior leaders, and work cooperatively across boundaries within a matrix organization.
Familiarity with the Pharmaceutical Industry.

Digital marketing and commercialization domain experience—including MarTech ecosystems.
AI/ML for marketing use cases—content personalization, audience segmentation, campaign optimization, and understanding of agentic AI architectures including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, and human-in-the-loop design.
Experience with ETL tools (AWS Glue, Informatica) and integration platforms (MuleSoft, webMethods).

Ability to scan the technical landscape for leading-edge solutions, create business cases for new investments, and potential to develop into a recognized thought-leader for content, digital, and AI capabilities.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics, Research Business Insights & Technology
new_jobs.description:
Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Role Overview

Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking a strategic, scientifically grounded leader to serve as the Senior Director for Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics. This leader will partner deeply with Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacometrics, Quantitative Pharmacology, and Translational Medicine stakeholders to deliver the applications, modeling environments, workflow automation, and governed operational capabilities that support CPP work end to end—from quantitative preclinical-to-clinical bridging through clinical PK/PD, dose and regimen decisions, and submission-support outputs.

This role supports the quantitative CPP layer across Research and Development, including pharmacometric workflows, clinical PK/PD systems, modeling platforms, reporting automation, regulatory evidence generation, and the governed operational capabilities required to run these workflows at scale.

Reporting to the Vice President, Research Business Insights & Technology, this leader will operate as part of a unified BI&T leadership team and act as a trusted partner to Research and Development leadership. The role carries accountability for the reliability, fit-for-purpose evolution, and long-term scaling of the CPP technology stack and workflow ecosystem, while working in a highly matrixed model with scientific leaders, data teams, lab-platform teams, and regulatory-facing partners.

Mission & Impact

Provide a scalable application and workflow backbone for CPP across preclinical-to-clinical translation, clinical PK/PD, dose selection, exposure-response, and model-informed development decisions
Improve the speed, quality, reproducibility, traceability, and inspection-readiness of pharmacometrics and clinical pharmacology workflows
Strengthen regulatory submissions through robust reporting, reusable quantitative evidence generation, and auditable outputs that support documents such as clinical pharmacology summaries and model-based appendices
Enable governed automation of priority CPP workflows, including reporting, simulation, execution, review, and knowledge reuse
Create a durable technology foundation for end-to-end CPP that can scale with pipeline demand and integrate cleanly across the broader Research and Development ecosystem

Sub-Areas in Scope

Clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics applications, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose optimization, and model-informed decision support
PBPK, QSP, drug-drug interaction, and other quantitative modeling environments used in CPP workflows
Clinical PK/PD systems and operational tooling that support end-to-end CPP execution
CPAR, Quarto-based or similar reporting automation, and submission-support workflows for quantitative regulatory deliverables
Quantitative translational workflows that bridge preclinical and clinical evidence in support of CPP decision-making
Workflow governance, audit trails, validation support, access controls, and inspection-ready operational practices for regulated quantitative environments
AI-enabled and advanced analytics capabilities that improve CPP workflow efficiency, simulation, review, reporting, and knowledge reuse
In partnership, but not sole ownership: translational labs, pathology, molecular and imaging lab workflows, CLIA-oriented lab operations, precision medicine diagnostics, and broad bioanalytical capabilities

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the single BI&T point of accountability for CPP technology, applications, workflows, and support services end to end
Partner across Research and Development to integrate CPP workflows with the scientific, data, and operational capabilities required for model-informed drug development
Own clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics applications, modeling environments, reporting workflows, and operational support for core CPP use cases
Ensure operational excellence, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement across modeling environments, clinical PK/PD systems, reporting workflows, and submission-support applications
Lead automation of priority CPP workflows, including model execution, reporting, simulation, traceability, review, and evidence reuse
Support quantitative regulatory deliverables through fit-for-purpose tooling, reproducible workflows, and inspection-ready practices
Partner with Unified Lab & Experimental Platforms, Target & Disease Biology, and In-Vivo & Non-Clinical Pharmacology where translational science, lab systems, diagnostics, biomarker workflows, or bioanalytical capabilities intersect with CPP needs
Partner with the R&D Data organization on underlying data-product strategy, integration, and fit-for-purpose data access
Lead and grow a team of scientific technologists, product leaders, and specialized engineers aligned to this domain

Required Experience & Qualifications

Ph.D. in Pharmacometrics, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biostatistics, or related quantitative field
12+ years in pharmaceutical R&D with deep clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and model-informed drug development experience
Proven experience implementing or leading CPP applications, PBPK and QSP environments, clinical PK/PD systems, or quantitative workflow automation
Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory submissions, quantitative reporting, and governed workflows in Development-facing settings
Experience applying AI/ML or advanced automation to quantitative modeling, reporting, or regulated scientific workflows is preferred
Director or Senior Director-level leadership experience; experience building and scaling a specialized scientific technology team is a strong differentiator

Critical Capabilities

Scientific Depth in Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics — Deep credibility with quantitative scientists and domain leaders across CPP
Strategic Partnership — Translates scientific and Development needs into practical, integrated technology and workflow solutions
Operational Leadership — Builds reliable, scalable, inspection-ready environments and support models for critical quantitative workflows
Regulatory Translation Capability — Understands how quantitative evidence is prepared, reported, reviewed, and used in regulatory settings

Leadership & Change Attributes

Strong partnership with senior scientific, clinical, and regulatory leaders
Comfort operating with regulatory and global Development stakeholders
Ability to recruit, develop, and retain highly specialized quantitative talent in a competitive market
Experience navigating matrixed organizations and building credibility quickly
Commitment to building a collaborative, high-performing culture in a growing team

What Differentiates Top Candidates

Experience as a clinical pharmacology or pharmacometrics technology leader inside a top-tier pharmaceutical R&D organization
Track record of applications, workflows, or platforms that improved dose selection, quantitative decision-making, or regulatory execution in Development-facing settings
Experience deploying workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, or advanced analytics in support of end-to-end CPP modeling, reporting, and decision-support operations
Demonstrated success building a specialized function from foundational capability to scaled organizational value while operating through strong matrix partnerships

About Charter

Charter Communications, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHTR) is the leading broadband and video company in the nation and the fastest growing mobile provider in its footprint, with services available to more than 70 million homes and small to large businesses across 45 states through its Spectrum brand. Founded in 1993, Charter has evolved from providing cable TV to streaming, and from high-speed Internet to a converged broadband, WiFi and mobile experience. Over the Spectrum Fiber Broadband Network and supported by our 100% U.S.-based employees, the Company offers Seamless Connectivity and Entertainment with Spectrum Internet®, Mobile, TV, and Voice products.

More information can be found at corporate.charter.com

Spectrum’s Field Operations business unit

Our Field Operations team is responsible for building, upgrading, maintaining and connecting customers to our advanced, always on, fiber powered network.

Vice President Field Engineering – Midwest Region

(Note: this position is based in Blue Ash with frequent travel throughout Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana, and western West Virginia)

The Vice President Field Engineering is responsible for ensuring the reliability of Spectrum's fiber broadband access network. The VP directs regional efforts for network upgrades, preventative maintenance, repairs, outage reduction and other efforts to meet Spectrum's customer commitments for reliable connectivity.

Implements and enhances consistent practices to ensure network health throughout the Region
Oversees Regional programs for demand and scheduled maintenance
Responsible for Regional adherence with company network engineering design standards including amplifier cascades, bandwidth migration and management
Works with Inside Plant (ISP) team on network upgrades, hub collapses, outages and other projects and initiatives requiring coordination between ISP and outside plant
Consults with Corporate Field Engineering and Network Technology Services (NTS) on strategic planning of rebuilds and system extensions and upgrades
Plans needs for third party resources for plant upgrades and repair
Represents the Region in operational reviews in connection with all Regional engineering initiatives
Responsible for Regional compliance with Federal Communications Commission and other federal and state regulatory network requirements
Oversees Regional disaster recovery efforts.

What You’ll Bring To Spectrum

Experience: Experience working and leading the field construction/engineering and/or network and maintenance functions in the cable/communication business (10+years), management of annual budget preparation and implementation (8 years), senior level management experience (10+years)
Education: Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field, or equivalent field experience; SCTE/BCTE certification or equivalent field experience
Industry and vendor specific certifications and training Advanced Knowledge of HFC, Advanced Video, and IP Networks
Knowledge of all FCC compliance reports and other rules and regulations, a comprehensive understanding of applicable local and state rules and regulations; Comprehensive understanding of OSHA rules and regulations, both federal and state; Comprehensive understanding of HVAC and power distribution systems; Advanced knowledge of Digital Transmission; Advanced knowledge of Electronic theory Advanced knowledge of Federal Communications Commission regulations; Advanced knowledge of Fiber Optic theory; Knowledge of National Electric Code and National Electric Safety Code
